tasks.title: Add a streaming summary helper
tasks.prompt: Implement summarize(values) in stats.py. It must accept any iterable of numbers, return a dictionary with count, total, and mean, and return mean as null for an empty iterable. Add tests in test_stats.py for a generator and an empty input.

tasks.title: Normalize a small configuration object
tasks.prompt: Implement normalizeConfig in config.js. It accepts an object and returns {host, port, secure}; host defaults to localhost, port defaults to 8080, and secure defaults to false. Add tests in config.test.js for defaults and an explicit configuration. Do not mutate the input.

tasks.title: Parse a simple key-value log
tasks.prompt: Create parse_log.py with parse_line(line), returning a dictionary for lines shaped as LEVEL message. Split only at the first space, strip the message, and return None for malformed or blank input. Add tests in test_parse_log.py for a normal line, a message containing spaces, and malformed input.
